checklist_100.item: 100 optional tasks (purple + black/pink-letter icons; there are far more than 100)
Study 100 of 255 animals (dogs and cats count by breed)
All Top Fun drone races at all 14 locations

facts.saves: 15 manual + 1 autosave — one at the start and end of each chapter.

steps: Play Chapters 1-5; story trophies pop automatically. No mission gold medals.
CHAPTER 1: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony, Accept the meditation.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (10 slots).
Scan new vehicles (WAiNK) and study animals (binoculars) as you travel: 100% needs 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Do optional missions as they appear (purple icons, black icons with pink letters).
After Coffee Break (Ch. 2): partner trophies, UFO abduction after 2 AM in Kelly County, character questlines.
phases.title: Phase 1 — Story and side missions
phases.trophies: 12 story trophies + the Chapter 1 meditation + early activities

steps: Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Nothing here is missable.
Clear every robbery: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults.
All 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting range golds, every drone race.
15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 flamingos, 200 vehicles, 100 animals.
70 of the 80 challenges — skip the 10 hardest.
15 Target Decks for Bret, 300 stunts, 100 optional tasks.
phases.title: Phase 2 — The 100% checklist
phases.trophies: A Long Road (gold) and most of the silver and bronze

steps: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and the rest.
Character questlines: Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret (Jason-only).
Leftover miscellaneous trophies: UFO, showroom Banshee, Ocean View cocktail, tank, plane, jewelry store.
Two honest unknowns: Bad Luck, I Guess has no confirmed method; Ten Pin's best lead is melee kicks from a motorcycle.
Vice Got a Price! pops when the other 54 are earned.
phases.title: Phase 3 — Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
phases.trophies: Strangers & Freaks (silver) + miscellaneous bronze + the platinum

platinum_route.text: Learn the one missable moment first: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
Play the story, Chapters 1-5 (60-80 h). Balcony meditation after Down to Earth; scan vehicles, study animals.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2) unlocks switching, do the partner trophies, the UFO abduction and the character questlines.
Finish the story, open the 100% checklist, and clear the robberies first: gang operations, bank jobs, payday loans, bank vaults.
Work the checklist in blocks: ranges (42 golds), drone races, stunts (300), challenges (70/80), cards (15 sets), WAiNK (100), flamingos (100).
Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and the character questlines. Money trophies finish themselves along the way.
Sweep the leftovers: showroom Banshee, Ocean View cocktail, tank, plane, jewelry store, Combat Focus. The platinum pops with the 54th trophy.
